name: Children's Week
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You're willing to help us here at the orphanage?  Bless you, friend; your aid during Children's Week will be invaluable.

Take this whistle.  You will only be able to use it for a short amount of time - typically not longer than Children's Week itself.  When you use it, you will be able to talk with the child you've agreed to look after.  Using it again will dismiss the child.

By all means adventurer - use the whistle and meet your ward!  I'm sure the child will be most eager to meet you.
narrative.objectives: Use the Orcish Orphan Whistle to talk with the child you will be looking after during Children's Week.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Zug zug! My name is Grunth, and I guess you're looking after me? You're an adventurer, like my mom and dad were. My matron says that they died with honor in battle. I'm happy to meet you.

I hope we'll do plenty of things together. I have some things I'd like to do, and the matron says you'll be like a big brother to me during this week. I'd like that a whole bunch.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests at level 60, 1,950 XP in all.

quests.name: Children's Week
quests.objectiveText: Use the Orcish Orphan Whistle to talk with the child you will be looking after during Children's Week.

quests.name: Down at the Docks
quests.objectiveText: Take your ward to the docks of Ratchet in the Barrens.

quests.name: Gateway to the Frontier
quests.objectiveText: Take your ward to the Mor'shan Rampart in the northern part of the Barrens, just before entering Ashenvale.

quests.name: Lordaeron Throne Room
quests.objectiveText: Take your ward to the old Lordaeron Throne Room that lies just before descending into the Undercity.
